sources.title: S. 4707 (IS) - Verifiable, Orderly, and Timely Election Results Act

supported_event_claim: Senator Rick Scott introduced the VOTER Act, requiring eligible ballots to be counted and reported within 24 hours after polls close.
reason: The official bill record identifies its sponsor, introduction date, and subject.

supported_event_claim: Former NGA director Robert Cardillo warned that a second Trump term would be a true crisis.
reason: No direct publication or credible report establishing this quote and its context was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: The synopsis says the Trump campaign threatened to cancel the debate unless Chris Wallace agreed not to discuss COVID-19 deaths.
reason: The source lead attributes a request to the Biden campaign but the precise threat to cancel and demand on Wallace were not verified by a direct credible source in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: The title alleges a Proud Boys automated text campaign to recruit election-day voter intimidators.
reason: Credible reporting located on election-related Proud Boys messages describes different messages and does not substantiate this specific campaign or purpose.

supported_event_claim: The synopsis says DHS's 2020 threat assessment identified white supremacists and Russian propaganda as the greatest threats.
reason: No published final assessment matching both claims and the described release date was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: A Pennsylvania judge dismissed a Trump campaign suit seeking to block absentee ballots.
reason: No matching court order or credible report confirming the stated lawsuit and ruling was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: The synopsis says Trump urged associates to pursue an executive order ending birthright citizenship before the election.
reason: No direct contemporaneous statement or credible report verifying this private proposal and timing was located.

supported_event_claim: A Roger Stone associate's firm registered the Stop The Steal Committee on October 16, 2020.
reason: No official registration record or credible report verifying the claimed registrant and relationship was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: EPA adopted a rule weakening the pesticide application exclusion zone protections on October 20, 2020.
reason: No Federal Register rule or EPA announcement matching this date and description was located.

supported_event_claim: U.S. intelligence officials warned Russia was interfering in the election and might breach election-related networks.
reason: No direct October 22 statement or credible report establishing this precise warning was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: At a Lansing rally Trump said Biden would be shot three weeks after inauguration.
reason: No reliable transcript or contemporaneous report verifying this precise quote was located.

supported_event_claim: More than 50,000 Facebook group posts called for violence or war if Trump lost.
reason: No research dataset, study, or credible report establishing the stated count and wording was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: Pennsylvania alerted the FBI that the Trump campaign sought election security details.
reason: No direct Pennsylvania agency communication or credible contemporaneous reporting confirming this event was located.

supported_event_claim: A Trump group urged Pennsylvania voters to submit ballots after Election Day.
reason: No primary message or credible report establishing the group and exact advice was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: Jared Kushner privately asked Rupert Murdoch to retract Fox News's Arizona election call.
reason: No direct credible reporting confirming the call and its alleged request was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: CNP members and others launched a Stop the Steal Facebook group and organized protests on November 4.
reason: No direct platform record or credible reporting establishing the described organizers and launch date was located.

supported_event_claim: The campaign's donation page directed up to 60 percent of election-defense donations to campaign debt.
reason: No archived donation page or contemporaneous credible reporting verifying this precise allocation was located.

supported_event_claim: Georgia representative Vernon Jones told a Trump campaign audience it was time to start shooting.
reason: No event video or credible contemporaneous report confirming the exact quote was located.

supported_event_claim: News reports said former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale was writing a tell-all book.
reason: No credible direct report establishing the book project and date was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: Representative Paul Gosar promoted claims that Dominion voting systems rigged the election.
reason: No direct public post or reliable contemporaneous article confirming the described action and date was located.

supported_event_claim: The Kremlin said Russia would withhold recognition of the U.S. election winner pending Trump's legal challenges.
reason: No direct Kremlin statement or credible report confirming this specific position was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: Alex Jones and InfoWars organized a Stop the Steal caravan from Texas to Washington, D.C.
reason: No event announcement or credible report confirming the route, organizer, and date was located.

supported_event_claim: James O'Keefe announced a $25,000 reward for proof of voter fraud on November 9, 2020.
reason: No primary announcement or credible contemporaneous report establishing the offer was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: Trump continued efforts to release classified intelligence on Russia around the 2020 election.
reason: No direct document or credible report establishing the specific release effort and date was located in this research pass.

supported_event_claim: A Trump adviser said the campaign was seeking to persuade 20 states to appoint faithless electors.
reason: No direct statement or credible report identifying the adviser and substantiating the claim was located.
